# Overview {#sec-overview}

```{r setup}
#| cache: false
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| output: false
#| code-summary: "Load packages and set display globals"

# Builds `models_pal`. Sourced first because it attaches igraph/colorspace,
# which mask terra/dplyr functions if loaded afterwards. It also creates a
# global `assigned_farms` (all countries, no geometry) that is overwritten below.
source(here::here("src", "species_colours.R"))

library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(terra)
library(qs2)
library(terra)
library(tidyterra)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(lubridate)
library(cmocean)
library(here)
```

```{r source-scripts}
#| cache: false
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| output: false
#| code-summary: "Source R scripts in use"

here("src", "dirs.R") %>% source()
here("src", "other_functions.R") %>% source()
here("src", "model_functions.R") %>% source()
here("src", "country_bboxes.R") %>% source()
```

The purpose of this document is to generate all the required report outputs (plots, data) for a single country. Change `this_iso` in the chunk below and re-render to produce outputs for a different country.

```{r choose-country}
#| code-summary: "Choose the country we're looking at."

this_iso <- "GRC"

assigned_farms <- file.path(prepdata_path, "assigned_farms.qs") %>% 
  qs_read() %>% 
  filter(ISO3_Code == this_iso)

farm_IDs <- unique(assigned_farms$farm_ID)

production_files <- file.path(outs_path, "data", "farm_production") %>% 
  list.files(recursive = F, full.names = T, pattern = "MC5000.qs") %>%
  str_subset(paste0(fix_int(farm_IDs, 8), collapse = "|"))

GLW_ls <- list(
  "GLW_1.5" = 2018:2037,
  "GLW_2.0" = 2032:2051,
  "GLW_3.0" = 2055:2074,
  "GLW_4.0" = 2075:2094
)

this_country  <- unique(assigned_farms$country)

# This fills out 1 cell of border around the EEZ HS values close to the coastline, purely to stop the ugly white spaces between the coast and the HS data. Note that this gapfilling technically extrapolates "fake" data within the country's EEZ, so country HS stats/numbers need to be calculated BEFORE gapfilling.
land       <- ne_countries(scale = "large", returnclass = "sf")
this_land  <- land %>% filter(iso_a3 == this_iso | adm0_a3 == this_iso)
coast_zone <- buffer(vect(this_land), 62500)   # band around the coast
fill_coastal_gaps <- function(r, w = 3) {
  filled <- focal(r, w, "mean", na.rm = TRUE, na.policy = "only")
  cover(r, mask(filled, coast_zone))       # only fill NAs that fall inside the coastal band
}

# Models present in this country, with a colour for each. Models not in`models_pal` (e.g. tuna) get a grey fallback.
models_here <- sort(unique(assigned_farms$model_name))
country_pal <- models_pal[models_here]
names(country_pal) <- models_here
country_pal[is.na(country_pal)] <- "grey50"

# Readable labels for model names
label_model <- function(x) str_replace_all(x, "_", " ") %>% str_to_sentence()

GLW_labels <- c("GLW_1.5" = "1.5°C", "GLW_2.0" = "2°C", "GLW_3.0" = "3°C", "GLW_4.0" = "4°C")

# prettyplot() removes the legend; add it back (with its title) for the report plots
report_theme <- function(legend = "bottom") {
  prettyplot() +
    theme(legend.position = legend, legend.title = element_text())
}

year_breaks <- seq(2025, 2095, 10)
```

# Farms {#sec-farms}

## Farm locations

Every assigned farm in `r this_country`, coloured by the species model it is run with.

```{r farm-map}
#| code-summary: "Map of assigned farms"
#| fig-width: 8.5
#| fig-height: 6.5

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = land, fill = "grey85", colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_sf(data = assigned_farms, aes(colour = model_name), size = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = country_pal, labels = label_model, name = "Model") +
  do.call(coord_sf, bbox_lims(this_iso)) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Assigned farms: ", this_country, " (", this_iso, ")"),
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  report_theme()
```

## Farms per model

The number of assigned farms per model, how many of those have completed production runs, and the production each model is assumed to represent.

```{r farms-per-model}
#| code-summary: "Summary table of farms per model"

# Farm IDs that actually have a production file
farm_IDs_done <- basename(production_files) %>% 
  str_extract("(?<=farmID_)\\d+") %>% 
  as.numeric()

assigned_farms %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  group_by(model_name) %>% 
  reframe(
    n_farms = n(),
    n_farms_with_production = sum(farm_ID %in% farm_IDs_done),
    production_t = unique(value),
    production_perfarm_t = unique(prod_perfarm)
  ) %>% 
  arrange(desc(production_t)) %>% 
  knitr::kable(
    digits = 0,
    col.names = c("Model", "Farms", "Farms with production run", "Production (t)", "Production per farm (t)")
  )
```

```{r failed-farms}
#| code-summary: "Examine production file error report for failed farms"

error_files <- file.path(outs_path, "production_check_issues.csv") %>% 
  read.csv() %>% 
  mutate(farm_ID = as.integer(str_remove_all(file, "production_results_farmID_|_MC5000.qs"))) %>% 
  filter(farm_ID %in% farm_IDs) %>% 
  left_join(assigned_farms, by = join_by(farm_ID)) %>% 
  group_by(model_name, detail, year) %>% 
  reframe(n_farms = n()) %>% 
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Model", "Error type", "Year", "No. farms")
  )
```

## Country production summary

```{r raw-production-data}
#| code-summary: "Report coverage FAO production data"

file.path(prepdata_path, "FAO_with_models.qs") %>% 
  qs_read() %>% 
  filter(period %in% 2014:2023 & ISO3_Code == this_iso) %>%
  mutate(model_name = case_when(
    model_name %in% c("drum", "large_yellow_croaker", "whitemouth_croaker", "meagre") ~ "drum_croaker", 
    model_name %in% c("red_seabream", "gilthead_seabream", "blackhead_seabream") ~ "seabream", 
    TRUE ~ model_name)
  ) %>% 
  group_by(ISO3_Code, country, environment, model_name, period) %>% 
  reframe(value = sum(value)) %>% 
  group_by(ISO3_Code, country, environment, model_name) %>% 
  reframe(value = mean(value)) %>% 
  mutate(included = case_when(model_name %in% models_here ~ T, T ~ F)) %>% 
  knitr::kable(
    digits = 1,
    col.names = c("ISO", "Country", "Environment", "Model", "Mean production (2014-2023)", "Included")
  )
```

Output of `country_summary()`: FAO-reported production (2014–2023) by model and by species within each model.

```{r country-summary}
#| code-summary: "Run country_summary()"

country_summary(this_iso)
```

# Farm production {#sec-production}

Annual biomass harvested and feed required, relative to the 2025 baseline, from the farm production model runs. Lines show the mean across farms within each model and ribbons show ± 1 standard deviation. Only farms with a completed production file are included (`r length(farm_IDs_done)` of `r length(farm_IDs)` farms).

```{r get-production-data}
#| code-summary: "Load farm production data"
#| cache: true

farm_data <- get_country_data(production_files, farm_IDs_done) %>% 
  left_join(
    assigned_farms %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(farm_ID, model_name),
    by = join_by(farm_ID)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    farm_ID = factor(farm_ID)
  )

# Some plotting globals
model_order <- farm_data %>% 
  group_by(model_name) %>% 
  reframe(biomass_2025 = mean(biomass_2025)) %>% 
  arrange(-biomass_2025) %>% 
  pull(model_name)

warming_cols <- c("1.5°C" = "#E9A23B", "2°C"   = "#DB5F32", "3°C"   = "#B3243B", "4°C"   = "#5C0F2E")
offsets <- c("1.5°C" = -0.24, "2°C" = -0.08, "3°C" = 0.08, "4°C" = 0.24)

# Shared plotting function: mean across farms (line) ± 1 SD (ribbon) per model
plot_farm_change <- function(df, y, ylab, title) {
  df %>% 
    group_by(model_name, year) %>% 
    reframe(
      mean = 100*mean({{ y }}, na.rm = T),
      sd = 100*sd({{ y }}, na.rm = T)
    ) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = year, colour = model_name, fill = model_name)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), alpha = 0.2, colour = NA) +
    geom_line(aes(y = mean), linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = country_pal, labels = label_model, name = "Model") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = country_pal, labels = label_model, name = "Model") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = year_breaks) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Year", y = ylab) +
    report_theme()
}
```

Median (and interquartile range) relative change across farms within each model, for each global warming level.

```{r production-GLW-summary}
#| code-summary: "Summarise production change per model and GLW"

# yrs <- GLW_ls[[1]]
# nm <- names(GLW_ls)[1]
farm_data_GLW <- map2_dfr(
  GLW_ls, 
  names(GLW_ls),
  function(yrs, nm) {
    farm_data %>% 
      filter(year %in% yrs) %>% 
      group_by(farm_ID, model_name) %>% 
      reframe(
        biomass_change_pct        = 100* mean(biomass_change_pct, na.rm = T),
        food_prov_change_pct      = 100* mean(food_prov_change_pct, na.rm = T),
        food_prov_biom_change_pct = 100* mean(food_prov_biom_change_pct, na.rm = T)
      ) %>% 
      mutate(GLW = nm)
  }
) %>% 
  mutate(GLW = factor(GLW, levels = names(GLW_labels), labels = GLW_labels))

farm_data_GLW %>% 
  group_by(model_name, GLW) %>% 
  reframe(
    n_farms = n(),
    biomass_median = median(biomass_change_pct, na.rm = T),
    biomass_q25 = quantile(biomass_change_pct, 0.25, na.rm = T),
    biomass_q75 = quantile(biomass_change_pct, 0.75, na.rm = T),
    feed_median = median(food_prov_biom_change_pct, na.rm = T),
    feed_q25 = quantile(food_prov_biom_change_pct, 0.25, na.rm = T),
    feed_q75 = quantile(food_prov_biom_change_pct, 0.75, na.rm = T)
  ) %>% 
  knitr::kable(
    digits = 1,
    col.names = c("Model", "GLW", "Farms", "Biomass median (%)", "Q25", "Q75", "Feed/biomass median (%)", "Q25", "Q75")
  )
```

## Change in biomass

```{r plot-biomass-change}
#| code-summary: "Plot change in harvested biomass"
#| fig-width: 8.5
#| fig-height: 5.5

plot_farm_change(
  farm_data, biomass_change_pct, 
  ylab = "Change in biomass from 2025 (%)", 
  title = paste0("Change in harvested biomass by model: ", this_country)
)
```

```{r plot-production-GLW-summary}
#| code-summary: "Plot production change per model and GLW"
#| fig-width: 8.5
#| fig-height: 5.5

farm_data_GLW %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = GLW, y = biomass_change_pct, fill = model_name)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6, colour = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = country_pal, labels = label_model, name = "Model") +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Change in production at each global warming level: ", this_country),
    x = "Global warming level", y = "Change from 2025 (%)"
  ) +
  report_theme()
```

```{r plot-production-GLW-summary-lines}
#| code-summary: "Plot production change per model and GLW - dot and line approach"
#| fig-width: 8.5
#| fig-height: 5.5

plt_data <- farm_data_GLW %>% 
  mutate(biomass_change_pct = biomass_change_pct/100) %>% 
  group_by(model_name, GLW) %>% 
  reframe(
    median = median(biomass_change_pct),
    q25 = quantile(biomass_change_pct, 0.25),
    q75 = quantile(biomass_change_pct, 0.75)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    model_name = factor(model_name, levels = rev(model_order)),
    y = as.numeric(model_name) + offsets[as.character(GLW)]
  ) 

plt_limits <- pct_limits(c(plt_data$q25, plt_data$q75))
plt_breaks <- pct_breaks(c(plt_data$q25, plt_data$q75))

plt_data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = y, y = median, colour = GLW)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_segment(aes(y = q25, yend = q75), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(y = median), size = 2.3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = warming_cols, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = plt_breaks,
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    limits = plt_limits,
    expand = expansion(0)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(rev(model_order)),
    labels = label_model(rev(model_order)),
    expand = expansion(add = 0.5)
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    y = "Projected change (%) weighted by current (2025) production",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 0, size = 3))) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title            = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle         = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(b = 6)),
    plot.title.position   = "plot",
    plot.caption.position = "plot",
    plot.caption          = element_text(hjust = 0, colour = "grey45", size = 9),
    legend.position       = "top",
    legend.justification  = "center",
    legend.text           = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.margin         = margin(b = -4),
    panel.grid.major.y    = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor      = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x    = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.text.y           = element_text(colour = "grey25", size = 10),
    axis.title.x          = element_text(margin = margin(t = 6)),
    plot.margin           = margin(10, 15, 10, 10)
  )
```

# Habitat suitability {#sec-habitat-suitability}

Habitat suitability (HS) across the EEZ, averaged over each global warming level (GLW) window. HS is the proportion of the year that temperature is suitable for feeding, so it ranges from 0 to 1. Only species that are actually farmed in `r this_country` are shown.

```{r load-HS}
#| code-summary: "Load habitat suitability rasters"
#| cache: true

HS_path  <- file.path(outs_path, "data", "habitat_suitability_decadal", this_iso)

# Species farmed here that have an HS raster
HS_models <- intersect(models_here, list.dirs(HS_path, full.names = F, recursive = F))
lyr_names <- c("ref_2015_2024", names(GLW_ls))

# One SpatRaster per species: layers = ref + each GLW, scaled to 0-1
HS_rasts <- map(
  set_names(HS_models),
  function(m) {
    fnms <- file.path(HS_path, m, paste0("MR_", lyr_names, ".tif"))
    r <- rast(fnms) / 365
    names(r) <- lyr_names
    r
  }
)

HS_rasts_gf <- map(HS_rasts, fill_coastal_gaps)
```

Models in this country without a habitat suitability raster: `r setdiff(models_here, HS_models) %>% label_model() %>% paste(collapse = ", ") %>% {if (. == "") "none" else .}`.

## Per species

```{r plot-HS-species}
#| code-summary: "Plot habitat suitability for each species at each GLW"
#| fig-width: 8.5
#| fig-height: 6.5
#| results: asis

plot_HS <- function(r, m) {
  ggplot() +
    geom_spatraster(data = r[[names(GLW_ls)]]) +
    geom_sf(data = land, fill = "grey85", colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_sf(data = filter(assigned_farms, model_name == m), shape = 4, size = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~lyr, nrow = 2, labeller = as_labeller(GLW_labels)) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = "viridis", 
      # limits = c(0, 1),
      na.value = "transparent", name = "Habitat\nsuitability"
    ) +
    do.call(coord_sf, bbox_lims(this_iso)) +
    labs(title = label_model(m), x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    report_theme(legend = "right") +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.key.height   = unit(4.5, "lines"),
      legend.key.width    = unit(1.2, "lines"),
      legend.frame        = element_rect(colour = "black"),
      legend.ticks        = element_line(colour = "black"),
      legend.ticks.length = unit(0.3, "lines")
    )
}

for (m in HS_models) {
  cat("\n\n### ", label_model(m), "\n\n")
  print(plot_HS(HS_rasts_gf[[m]], m))
}
```

## Change per species

Relative change in habitat suitability at each GLW compared to the 2015–2024 reference period.

```{r plot-HS-species-change}
#| code-summary: "Plot change in habitat suitability for each species at each GLW"
#| fig-width: 8.5
#| fig-height: 6.5
#| results: asis

HS_change <- map(HS_rasts, \(r) (r[[names(GLW_ls)]] - r[["ref_2015_2024"]]) / r[["ref_2015_2024"]])
HS_change_gf <- map(HS_change, fill_coastal_gaps)

plot_HS_change <- function(r, m) {
  lim <- max(abs(minmax(r)), na.rm = T)
  ggplot() +
    geom_spatraster(data = r) +
    geom_sf(data = land, fill = "grey85", colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_sf(data = filter(assigned_farms, model_name == m), shape = 4, size = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~lyr, nrow = 2, labeller = as_labeller(GLW_labels)) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      limits = c(-lim, lim), colours = rev(cmocean("balance")(256)), 
      labels = scales::label_percent(), na.value = "transparent", 
      name = "Change in\nhabitat\nsuitability"
    ) +
    do.call(coord_sf, bbox_lims(this_iso)) +
    labs(title = label_model(m), x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    report_theme(legend = "right") +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.key.height   = unit(4.5, "lines"),
      legend.key.width    = unit(1.2, "lines"),
      legend.frame        = element_rect(colour = "black"),
      legend.ticks        = element_line(colour = "black"),
      legend.ticks.length = unit(0.3, "lines")
    )
}

for (m in HS_models) {
  cat("\n\n### ", label_model(m), "\n\n")
  print(plot_HS_change(HS_change_gf[[m]], m))
}
```

## Production-weighted habitat suitability

The species rasters combined into a single stack (one layer per GLW) by taking the mean across species, weighted by each species' current production in the country.

```{r HS-weighted}
#| code-summary: "Combine species HS rasters into a production-weighted stack"

HS_weights <- assigned_farms %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  distinct(model_name, value) %>% 
  filter(model_name %in% HS_models)
HS_weights <- set_names(HS_weights$value, HS_weights$model_name)[HS_models]

weighted_HS <- function(rasts, weights) {
  w <- weights / sum(weights)
  Reduce(`+`, map2(rasts, w, \(r, wi) r * wi))
}

HS_weighted <- weighted_HS(HS_rasts, HS_weights)
HS_change_weighted <- weighted_HS(HS_change, HS_weights)

HS_weighted
```

Weights used:

```{r HS-weights-table}
#| code-summary: "Table of production weights"
tibble(model = label_model(names(HS_weights)), production_t = HS_weights, weight = HS_weights / sum(HS_weights)) %>% 
  knitr::kable(digits = c(0, 0, 3), col.names = c("Model", "Production (t)", "Weight"))
```

```{r plot-HS-weighted}
#| code-summary: "Plot production-weighted habitat suitability"
#| fig-width: 8.5
#| fig-height: 6.5

HS_weighted_gf <- fill_coastal_gaps(HS_weighted)

ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = HS_weighted_gf) +
  geom_sf(data = land, fill = "grey85", colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_sf(data = filter(assigned_farms, model_name %in% HS_models), shape = 4, size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~lyr, nrow = 2, labeller = as_labeller(GLW_labels)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "viridis", limits = c(0, 1),
    na.value = "transparent", name = "Habitat\nsuitability"
  ) +
  do.call(coord_sf, bbox_lims(this_iso)) +
  labs(title = paste0("Production-weighted habitat suitability: ", this_country), x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  report_theme(legend = "right") +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.key.height   = unit(4.5, "lines"),
    legend.key.width    = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    legend.frame        = element_rect(colour = "black"),
    legend.ticks        = element_line(colour = "black"),
    legend.ticks.length = unit(0.3, "lines")
  )
```

## EEZ-wide summary

Mean habitat suitability (and mean change relative to the reference period) across the whole EEZ, per species and production-weighted.

```{r HS-summary-table}
#| code-summary: "Summarise HS across the EEZ, weight HS and % change from reference period"

# Mean HS per period for each species raster plus the production-weighted stack
summarise_HS <- function(rasts, weighted) {
  map2_dfr(
    c(rasts, list(`Production-weighted` = weighted)),
    c(label_model(names(rasts)), "Production-weighted"),
    function(r, nm) {
      global(r, "mean", na.rm = T) %>% 
        rownames_to_column("period") %>% 
        mutate(model = nm)
    }
  ) %>% 
    rename(mean_HS = mean) %>% 
    group_by(model) %>% 
    mutate(change = 100*(mean_HS - mean_HS[period == "ref_2015_2024"]) / mean_HS[period == "ref_2015_2024"]) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(period = recode(period, !!!GLW_labels, ref_2015_2024 = "Reference (2015–2024)"))
}

summarise_HS(HS_rasts, HS_weighted) %>% 
  select(model, period, mean_HS, change) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = period, values_from = c(mean_HS, change)) %>% 
  select(-`change_Reference (2015–2024)`) %>% 
  knitr::kable(
    digits = 1,
    col.names = c("model", "Reference (2015–2024)", "1.5°C", "2°C", "3°C", "4°C", "1.5°C (%)", "2°C (%)", "3°C (%)", "4°C (%)")
  )
```

The same summary, restricted to sea cells within 50 km of the coastline of `r this_country`. Cells are kept if their centre falls inside a 62 km (50 + 25/2) buffer around the country's land polygon; cells near other countries' coasts but outside this buffer are excluded.

```{r HS-summary-table-coastal}
#| code-summary: "Summarise HS within 50 km of the coast"

coast_zone <- land %>% 
  filter(iso_a3 == this_iso | adm0_a3 == this_iso) %>% 
  vect() %>% 
  project(crs(HS_weighted)) %>% 
  buffer(62000)

HS_rasts_coastal <- map(HS_rasts, \(r) mask(r, coast_zone))
HS_weighted_coastal <- mask(HS_weighted, coast_zone)

summarise_HS(HS_rasts_coastal, HS_weighted_coastal) %>% 
  select(model, period, mean_HS, change) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = period, values_from = c(mean_HS, change)) %>% 
  select(-`change_Reference (2015–2024)`) %>% 
  knitr::kable(
    digits = 1,
    col.names = c("model", "Reference (2015–2024)", "1.5°C", "2°C", "3°C", "4°C", "1.5°C (%)", "2°C (%)", "3°C (%)", "4°C (%)")
  )
```
